literal: Worthy people, worthiness they are without, that which is said, by their respective remainders to be seen will be.
translation: Whether people are just or unjust will be seen by what they leave behind.
modern: ஒருவர் நடுவுநிலைமை உடையவரா அல்லது இல்லாதவரா என்பது, அவர் தமக்குப்பின் விட்டுச்செல்லும் எச்சத்தால் அறியப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how to judge a person's true character and impartiality. The word 'தக்கார்' refers to those who are worthy and just, while 'தகவிலர்' refers to those lacking such equity. The key word 'எச்சம்' means 'remainder' or 'what is left behind', which can be understood as their legacy, reputation, or offspring. Ultimately, whether a person was truly impartial is revealed to the world by the lasting impact and legacy they leave after their time.
